question.question: Where did Dave return from with new knowledge of different techniques of car restoration?

evidence_items.text:
Dave: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.
[S4T15] (dia_id: D4:15)

Calvin: Keep going for it!
[S4T16] (dia_id: D4:16)

Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
[Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]
[S4T17] (dia_id: D4:17)

Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
[S4T18] (dia_id: D4:18)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
[S4T19] (dia_id: D4:19)

Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
[S4T20] (dia_id: D4:20)

Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
[S4T21] (dia_id: D4:21)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
[S4T22] (dia_id: D4:22)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.
[S4T23] (dia_id: D4:23)

Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
[Image caption: a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant]
[S4T24] (dia_id: D4:24)

- Opening the shop was his dream and is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars [S4T3][S4T5].
- Calvin congratulated him, said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised his "guts and ambition", and told him to keep it up [S4T2][S4T4].
- Called opening the shop a "labor of love" — challenging, but "so worth it"; feeling the hard work pay off is "like bringing something back to life" (echoing his car-restoration sentiment), and he finds it incredible that his skills and hard work made it happen [S4T9][S4T11][S4T13].
- Says the "perfect blend of dedication and passion" keeps him motivated and makes it all worthwhile; Calvin encouraged him to "keep going for it!" [S4T14][S4T15][S4T16].
- Shared a second photo of the shop (a group of people standing in front of a car) and invited Calvin to come by sometime [S4T17].
- Works on all kinds of cars at the shop — from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars — which "keeps [him] busy and happy" [S4T18][S4T19].
- Working on cars is what he's passionate about: doing it every day is "so rewarding", "seeing the transformation is awesome", and he finds it satisfying to help people keep their cars in good condition [S4T21].
- Appreciates Calvin's encouragement: "It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others" [S4T23].

Dave: Hey Cal, how's it going? Something cool happened since last we talked - I got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco! So cool to dive into the world of car restoration and see all the different techniques. People were really passionate and dedicated - truly inspiring!
[S14T1] (dia_id: D14:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! That's awesome! Car workshops sound totally cool and inspiring. Glad you found something that really gets you going.
[S14T2] (dia_id: D14:2)

Dave: It's always great to learn and grow. So, what have you been up to lately?
[S14T3] (dia_id: D14:3)

Calvin: As you know, I had an amazing experience touring with a well-known artist. The feeling of performing and connecting with the audience was unreal. We ended with a show in Japan and then I had the opportunity to explore my new place - it's like a dream come true!
[S14T4] (dia_id: D14:4)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! I bet playing for an eager audience was an incredible experience. Exploring Japan must have been amazing! How did Tokyo react to your music? Did you have any special moments there?
[S14T5] (dia_id: D14:5)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! That show in Tokyo was awesome! Everyone was so into it when I played one of my songs and sang along. It was a magical moment.
[S14T6] (dia_id: D14:6)

- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave telling Calvin "No worries... Got it. Good luck with your music!"; Calvin thanked him for the encouragement and said he'll keep working hard and making music, and Dave signed off "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later." [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].
- On 2023-08-14, reconnected with Calvin ("since last we talked"): Dave told him he got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco (details in ## Car workshops in San Francisco); Calvin: "That's awesome! Car workshops sound totally cool and inspiring. Glad you found something that really gets you going." [S14T1][S14T2]. Dave then asked what Calvin had been up to; Calvin told him the amazing experience of touring with the well-known artist — the tour ended with a show in Japan, and afterward he got to explore his new place (details in the Tokyo trip section of /memories/calvin.md). Dave bet playing for an eager audience was incredible and asked how Tokyo reacted to Calvin's music and about special moments; Calvin said the Tokyo show was "awesome" — the crowd sang along to one of his songs, "a magical moment" — and when Dave asked for pictures from the show, Calvin shared one (a crowd at the concert with their hands up), saying these moments are why he loves his job; Dave: "The energy in that pic is awesome! Seeing everyone with their hands up must have been really cool. It's great when your passion brings joy to others!" [S14T4][S14T5][S14T6][S14T7][S14T8][S14T9].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Dave told Calvin the car restoration is "going great" and shared a photo of it (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin predicted it "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long it would take. Dave said Calvin's support "means a lot to [him]" [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13][S14T15].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on — "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" — after Calvin said Dave "has some serious talent" and he was "really excited to see the end result of [Dave's] hard work" [S14T14][S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends on 2023-08-18 (details in ## Card night (2023-08-18)); Calvin told him he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true" — and Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained that he met Frank at a music festival in Tokyo, they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and "We all felt connected, it was amazing!", sharing a photo of the crowd sitting on the grass at night (Calvin's side in the Frank Ocean collaboration section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8].

Dave: That's cool. Using your music to share experiences and feelings, is it cathartic for you?
[S25T11] (dia_id: D25:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's a way for me to express myself and work through my emotions. It's like my own form of therapy.
[S25T12] (dia_id: D25:12)

Dave: Yeah, I get it. Cars give me an outlet to express myself. It's like a little oasis of calm. Whenever I'm working on one, it's like I'm connecting back with myself. And yeah, the music helps too! Look at my garage, a little dirty, but everything is in its place.
[Image caption: a photography of a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall]
[S25T13] (dia_id: D25:13)

Calvin: Looking cool - what made you start working on cars?
[S25T14] (dia_id: D25:14)

Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car in a garage]
[S25T15] (dia_id: D25:15)

Calvin: Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life. Was it a classic car? Do you still have it or are you currently working on another project?
[S25T16] (dia_id: D25:16)

Dave: Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector. Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge! Take a look at this wonderful car!
[Image caption: a photo of a black car parked in a parking lot]
[S25T17] (dia_id: D25:17)

Calvin: Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?
[S25T18] (dia_id: D25:18)

Dave: It takes a lot of patience, but the payoff is worth it. Paying extra attention to detail isn't easy, but it pays off.
[S25T19] (dia_id: D25:19)

Calvin: Yeah, details can really make a difference. It's what makes something great, like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car.
[S25T20] (dia_id: D25:20)

Dave: Yeah, for sure Calvin! Paying attention to details makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles. Little things can make a big impact!
[S25T21] (dia_id: D25:21)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Paying attention to those small details makes a difference. Without them, it's just average. As an artist, I want to create something extraordinary!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver disc in a black frame on a table]
[S25T22] (dia_id: D25:22)

- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].
- On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].
- On 2023-10-04, after Calvin asked for pictures of the restoration looking amazing ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"), shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." [S21T5][S21T6].
- On 2023-10-04, shared a photo of his own hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result." [S21T8].
- On 2023-10-25, told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!") — his professional learning alongside his San Francisco car workshops, see above (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-25 entry of the Relationships section of this file) [S26T2][S26T3].

Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
[Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
[S4T1] (dia_id: D4:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
[Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
[S4T2] (dia_id: D4:2)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.
[S4T3] (dia_id: D4:3)

Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]
[S4T4] (dia_id: D4:4)

Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
[S4T5] (dia_id: D4:5)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
[Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
[S4T6] (dia_id: D4:6)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Car workshops in San Francisco
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-14, told Calvin he got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco — "So cool to dive into the world of car restoration and see all the different techniques"; the people there were "really passionate and dedicated" — "truly inspiring!" [S14T1]. (Related to his car passion and auto engineering, see ## Classic cars)
- On 2023-09-02, said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and that he came back from a (second) trip to San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" that he wanted to share with Calvin — he finds "changing things around, and giving an old car a new life" "so satisfying!" (A separate trip from the 2023-08-14 workshop visit above.) [S17T1]

Dave: Hey Calvin, been ages! Guess what? I got picked for a car mod workshop. Gonna get better at it and learn something new! Look at the cars I'm working with right now. 
[Image caption: a photography of a man standing in front of a car on a lift]
[S13T1] (dia_id: D13:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Congrats on being picked for the car mod workshop. It's a great opportunity to take your skills up a notch. Are there any mods or projects you're excited to work on?
[S13T2] (dia_id: D13:2)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! This is a dream come true for me, as I've always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.
[S13T3] (dia_id: D13:3)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Pursuing your passion for auto engineering and making a custom car is a great experience. I'm excited to see what you create. Keep it up and have fun every step of the way. What do you think is the most thrilling part of it?
[S13T4] (dia_id: D13:4)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I've found the picture with really thrilling part of the workshop, take a look. Seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying.
[Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
[S13T5] (dia_id: D13:5)

Calvin: Wow, that sounds like a fulfilling hobby! What kind of transformations have you done so far? How's it going with the current project?
[S13T6] (dia_id: D13:6)

Dave: I've been working on this car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications. Now I'm learning about body modifications. Giving this classic muscle car a modern twist is a challenge but so fun!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver corvette parked in front of a building]
[S13T7] (dia_id: D13:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that looks cool! The silver finish gives it a modern twist. Great job!
[S13T8] (dia_id: D13:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, I wanted a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style. Really happy with it!
[S13T9] (dia_id: D13:9)

Calvin: You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great.
[S13T10] (dia_id: D13:10)

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-11, got picked for a car mod workshop — called it "a dream come true", since he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car (ties to his stated dream of building a custom car from scratch, see ## Classic cars); Calvin congratulated him [S13T1][S13T3].
- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up? I'm tied up with car stuff lately, yesterday I came back from San Francsico with some great insights and knowledge on car modification that I want to share with you! Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!
[S17T1] (dia_id: D17:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to hear from you. That's cool! I totally understand the satisfaction you get from fixing cars. It's like you're giving them new life.
[S17T2] (dia_id: D17:2)

Dave: Yeah, it's great fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better. It's really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose. Plus, it feels like I'm making a difference when I fix someone's car.
[S17T3] (dia_id: D17:3)

Calvin: Wow, you must feel great making a real difference in someone's life, like being their superhero!
[S17T4] (dia_id: D17:4)

Dave: Yeah, it's great! It feels really good to make a difference and see their relief when their car is fixed. Makes me proud!
[S17T5] (dia_id: D17:5)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! You should be really proud of yourself for bringing joy to others. I booked a flight ticket to Boston last week! I'm so excited about my upcoming trip to Boston. Look at this! See you soon, buddy!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a boarding pass and a boarding pass]
[S17T6] (dia_id: D17:6)
